tasks.label: Run Tests
tasks.command: g++ -O2 -std=c++17 engine/board.cpp engine/evaluate.cpp engine/transposition.cpp engine/search.cpp test.cpp -o test_runner.exe; if ($?) { ./test_runner.exe }

tasks.label: Build WASM
tasks.command: cd emsdk; ./emsdk_env.ps1; cd ..; em++ -O2 -std=c++17 engine/board.cpp engine/evaluate.cpp engine/transposition.cpp engine/search.cpp main.cpp -s WASM=1 -s EXPORTED_FUNCTIONS='["_ResetBoard","_MakeMove","_CheckWin","_IsFull","_GetBoard","_GetHistoryR","_GetHistoryC","_GetHistoryP","_GetHistoryCount","_GetBestMove"]' -s EXPORTED_RUNTIME_METHODS='["HEAP32"]' -s ALLOW_MEMORY_GROWTH=1 -o web/gomoku.js
